sections.title: ABSTRACT
sections.extract: This thesis explores a construction of the family of topological invariants for certain oriented 3-manifolds based on the state-integral approach developed by Andersen, Garoufalidis, and Kashaev in the Archimedean setting. sections.title: Motivation and Background
sections.extract: Motivation and Background This thesis considers a class of analytic topological constructions known as face- type state-integrals, focusing on their formulation over Archimedean local fields. These integrals originate in a framework developed by Andersen, Garoufalidis, and Kashaev, which draws together tools from quantum topology, Teichm¨uller theory, and aspects of quantum group representation theory.
